blurb: Get ready for a sweet adventure on the new San Diego Underground Donut Tour! In about 2 hours, you'll visit four of the city’s favorite donut and pastry shops, starting with the famous Devil’s Dozen Donuts, known for its devilishly good creations and a rooftop with stunning views. Then, stroll through a historic district to a bakery filled with irresistible pastries, followed by a local coffee roastery serving fresh brews and donuts. The tour wraps up at The Donut Bar, where you'll indulge in their oversized donuts. Along the way, enjoy the charm of Little Italy’s history, farmers market, and waterfront views. Each stop offers its own unique atmosphere, from the cozy bakery to the relaxed coffee roastery. Ready for a sugar-filled adventure? Book your tour today and treat yourself to San Diego’s best donuts!
